rationale: C17 is a concise commission-termination order using the same distinctive liquidation-of-affairs framework as the child: another department is assigned responsibility for winding up a commission and handling its residual resources. The child materially elaborates that template by specifying custody of remaining records and property, post-termination voucher certification, and eventual lawful disposal. C20 and C23 also contain liquidation and asset-transfer machinery, but concern a successor agency in a broader reorganization and are less closely matched to the child’s stand-alone commission wind-up structure.
